documents.review_rationale: Publicly downloadable policy wording PDF served directly from the insurer's official download-documents domain (bajajgeneralinsurance.com), matching the same primary_legal / reusable_generic pattern already used for other Bajaj Allianz and Aditya Birla Health policy wordings registered in this factory.
